seo.title: Burberry: genAI clienteling copilot (Penguin) - +24% average transaction value (2025)
seo.meta_description: Penguin, Burberry's in-house generative clienteling platform, delivers a 24% lift in average transaction value across customer service channels and equips 100+ consultants.
seo.resume_citable: Penguin, the genAI clienteling copilot Burberry built in-house, delivered a 24% lift in average transaction value across customer service channels and equipped more than 100 consultants across every market.

faq.q: What did Penguin deliver for Burberry?
faq.a: A 24% lift in average transaction value across customer service channels, with more than 100 consultants equipped, per the 2025 DataIQ Awards.
Natural language product search, recognition of a Burberry item from a photo, and generation of complete outfits consistent with the brand aesthetic.

pattern: genAI copilot for consultants (search, image recognition, complete-the-look)
objectif_business: Give Burberry customer service consultants a genAI copilot that speeds up product search, item recognition, and outfit suggestions, so they serve customers faster and raise transaction value.
description: Penguin is a generative platform built in-house by a three-person data science team together with customer service. It combines three functions: multilingual natural language product search, street-to-shop image recognition that identifies a Burberry product in a photo and matches it to the catalog, and a complete-the-look feature that generates coherent outfit suggestions in line with the brand aesthetic from a single item. Penguin relies on transformers and LLMs fine-tuned on Burberry looks. In parallel, Burberry runs a suite of data models (intent, recommendation, product affinity) that powers store-led campaigns. The effort was recognized at the 2025 DataIQ Awards.
points_cles: Penguin GenAI copilot for consultants: product search, street-to-shop image recognition, complete-the-look.
Built in-house (transformers and LLMs fine-tuned on Burberry looks) by a three-person team.
+24% average transaction value across customer service channels, 100+ consultants equipped.
Evidence level B, live status confirmed (2025 DataIQ Awards).

resultats.metrique: Average transaction value lift (customer service channels)
Store-led campaigns using the AI framework

niveau_preuve.justification: Two award-winning 2025 DataIQ Awards submissions quantifying separately the clienteling copilot (Penguin, +24% ATV) and the data transformation (7M GBP incremental). Quantified case study, judged by an industry third party, not a figure from the brand alone.

stack_technique.detail: Language models adapted to the brand's curated corpus of looks for complete-the-look; the base model is not named in the sources.
Detection of a Burberry product in a photo and matching to the catalog, integrated into Penguin.
Penguin's search function, built in-house on the product catalog.
In-house models that power store-led campaigns, with more than 90% of store-led campaigns using this framework.

fonctionnement_operationnel.cadence: Real time during the customer interaction; the product and look models are retrained as collections evolve
fonctionnement_operationnel.opere_par: Customer service consultants, equipped by the in-house data science team (three people) and customer service
fonctionnement_operationnel.signal_pilote: The up-to-date product catalog and the curated Burberry looks used for fine-tuning. Without this brand corpus, complete-the-look drifts away from the aesthetic and loses credibility.

etapes.detail: The consultant asks a product question in natural language or uploads a photo of an item to identify.
Penguin interprets the query or detects the product in the image (street-to-shop) and links it to the catalog.
From a single item, complete-the-look generates suggestions consistent with Burberry looks.
The consultant validates, adjusts, and delivers the response to the customer, staying in control of the relationship.

prerequis_orga: in-house data science team able to fine-tune LLMs
customer service involved in the design
change management on the consultant side
stack_possible: open or API LLM with fine-tuning
replication.premiere_etape: Prototype a natural language product search plus a complete-the-look on a catalog, tested with a handful of consultants.

playbook.action: Structure the catalog (attributes, images) and curate a brand look corpus with the style teams.
playbook.livrable: Training corpus validated by style leadership.

playbook.action: Prototype the natural language product search on the catalog and have it tested by a handful of consultants.
playbook.livrable: Prototype tested with documented consultant feedback.

playbook.action: Add image recognition and the complete-the-look fine-tuned on the look corpus.
playbook.livrable: Three-function copilot piloted on a limited scope.

playbook.action: Roll out to consultants in one market with training; the consultant keeps control of the response to the customer.
playbook.livrable: Adoption measured in a first market.

playbook.action: Compare average transaction value across equipped and non-equipped channels, then decide on expansion to other markets.
playbook.livrable: Average transaction value review and rollout plan.

replication.equipe: 2-3 data scientists + customer service involved in the design + 1 retail sponsor for consultant adoption.

statut_vivant.note: Platform recognized at the 2025 DataIQ Awards, adopted across all markets. Built and maintained in-house by the data science team.

transposable_ue.note: British group. The clienteling component relies on opt-in customer data (behavior, history). A processing legal basis and data minimization need to be set for real-time use of in-store data on the EU side.
